system.description:
Character returns after death if remnants are preserved. Revival time decreases with level.
Level 1: Reincarnates in 1 month
Level 2: Reincarnates in 1 week
Level 3: Reincarnates in 1 day
Level 4: Reincarnates in 12 hours
Level 5: Reincarnates in 1 hour
Level 6: Reincarnates in 1 minute
